about: Readings of disclosure statements' scanned PDFs, entered by a person who read each one (#2347). The PDFs have no text layer, so nothing here is machine-read. image_fingerprint is the sha256 over each PDF's page images; scripts/record_disclosure_statement_readings.py refuses a reading whose kept PDF shows different images. A blank line on the form is null and prints 'Not reported'. Sources carry name, city and state only. The officer who signed a statement is never recorded.
